board: Seeed Studio Grove - 4-Digit Display v1.0 (SKU 104030003, TM1637)
reason: Check passed first run on ESP32 and Pico (spec, wiring, design checks, breadboard, simulator test 09:45 then -25, PCB DRC). Pin order CLK/DIO/VCC/GND from Seeed's Eagle schematic J1 (10k pull-ups on CLK/DIO, colon on digit 2 bit 7); driver follows the TM1637 datasheet two-wire LSB-first protocol (0x40, 0xC0+data, 0x88|brightness); marked cabled because the board has a 2 mm Grove socket.
breakoutPinoutSource: Seeed Grove - 4-Digit Display V1.0 Eagle schematic J1: 1 CLK, 2 DIO, 3 VCC, 4 GND (https://files.seeedstudio.com/wiki/Grove_4_Digit_Display/resource/Grove%20-%204-Digit%20Display%20V1.0%20eagle%20files.zip) and Seeed wiki wire table (https://wiki.seeedstudio.com/Grove-4-Digit_Display/)
